about: M28 Phase 2 end to end. The same steps as Phase2EndToEndTests drives through the Mac window. Run: opcli scenario tests/scenarios/m28-phase2.json -o <out-dir>

input.ui: File > Open the JPEG. The app decodes it with ImageIO, turned by EXIF orientation 6, Display P3 profile kept; the file states no resolution, so 96 pixels per inch. ImageIO's pixels are in the .imageio.png (make-fixture.swift); the engine's own JPEG decoder is within 3 levels of them

steps.ui: Image > Crop Tool, aspect 3:2, straighten 4 degrees, Crop
Adjustments > Curves, Luminosity, the fixed S curve, OK
Adjustments > Hue / Saturation, hue 30, saturation 140, lightness -10, OK
History panel: click the Crop row (two steps back)
History panel: click the Curves row (one step forward)
